purpose: FlightTempo weather-provider contract. This file describes live provider endpoints and access constraints; it is not a weather-data snapshot.

providers.name: NOAA Aviation Weather Center Data API

products.coverage: Primarily US and North Atlantic; not worldwide
products.notes: Contains pilot-reported turbulence and icing; treat as observations, not forecasts.

products.coverage: Worldwide SIGMET feed (legacy endpoint; verify overlap before merging)

products.notes: The existing app's surface-analysis request returns HTTP 404. Do not draw synthetic pressure centers as a fallback; show the layer as unavailable until a supported source is verified.

notes: Use ICAO identifiers for METAR/TAF route-airport lookups.
Use the provider's global SIGMET cache rather than polling hundreds of per-FIR requests.
Do not exceed the documented 100 requests/minute limit or 400-result per-query limit.
The API does not enable browser CORS. A native Android HTTP client is not subject to browser CORS, but must still use a descriptive User-Agent and caching.
This provider exposes global observations, forecasts and SIGMET warnings; it does not provide a verified worldwide gridded turbulence/icing forecast through the documented Data API.

Probe result: /isigmet and /sigmet GeoJSON endpoints return 200; /airsigmet returns 200. The app's /surface?format=geojson endpoint returns HTTP 404 and must not be represented with hardcoded H/L pressure centers.

providers.name: NOAA Aviation Weather Center Graphical Forecasts for Aviation

products.coverage: United States including Alaska and Hawaii, Gulf/Caribbean and portions of Atlantic/Pacific
products.notes: GTG/EDR turbulence guidance. Not global. No supported machine-readable integration endpoint verified in this repository.
Current Icing Product combines NWP, radar, METAR, PIREP, satellite and lightning inputs. Not a worldwide icing grid.

providers.name: Deutscher Wetterdienst aviation EDP/ADWICE

access.authentication: DWD SWIM/MET-CEUS subscription and HTTP Basic Authentication required for protected aviation hazard layers
access.price: DWD catalogue lists EDP/ADWICE products as free of charge for aviation; access and public app rights are separate questions

providers.notes: Do not enable until DWD confirms access, app display, caching and redistribution rights and provides credentials or a public layer.

providers.name: HiFi Active Sky XP 12
providers.scope: User-owned local licensed X-Plane 12 installation only

access.documentationLocation: ASXP12 Program Files installation folder / Documentation subfolder
access.authentication: follow installed API documentation; not assumed

notes: Official HiFi product information confirms a comprehensive third-party API with an easy-access HTTP interface for getting and setting weather.
The API documentation is supplied in the local ASXP12 installation's Documentation subfolder.
Use read-only GET methods only for FlightTempo; do not alter simulator weather mode or conditions.
Exact endpoint paths, port, authentication, payload schema and supported weather fields must be read from the installed build's API PDF before implementation.
A newer ASXP12 update added comprehensive area-weather retrieval; use the installed build's documentation.
Simulator effects such as turbulence, drafts, thermals and microbursts must not be presented as forecast EDR/CAT data unless the API explicitly defines a forecast product and units.
Do not access HiFi DataNet directly, scrape protected endpoints or redistribute/proxy HiFi weather output without written permission.

providers.name: Open-Meteo Global Weather Forecast API

products.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com — CC BY 4.0
notes: Use geopotential_height to associate pressure levels with actual model altitude.
These are numerical weather prediction fields, not a turbulence or icing forecast.
Any vertical-shear calculation must be labelled as a non-operational model-derived indicator, not EDR/CAT.
The hosted free API is strictly for non-commercial use; a commercial FlightTempo release needs a separate licence or a self-hosted source arrangement.
Attribution under CC BY 4.0 is mandatory.

globalCoverageSummary.notes: A public no-key global feed is verified for METAR, TAF and SIGMET. No public no-key global gridded turbulence/icing forecast has been verified. DWD protected EDP/ADWICE access and HiFi local API remain gated.
